controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-nginx.access-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T19:02:22.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T20:02:22.000Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
| KEEP @timestamp, url.original, http.request.method, user_agent.original, source.ip
| SORT @timestamp ASC
